ruleDefinitions.name: PUA - Ngrok Execution
ruleDefinitions.description:
Detects the use of Ngrok, a utility used for port forwarding and tunneling, often used by threat actors to make local protected services publicly available.
Involved domains are bin.equinox.io for download and *.ngrok.io for connections.

sequences.query: ((process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ tcp\\ 139.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ tcp\\ 445.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ tcp\\ 3389.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ tcp\\ 5985.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ tcp\\ 5986.*")) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ start\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-\\-all.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-\\-config.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.yml.*")) OR (process_path = RGX("ngrok\\\.exe$") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ tcp\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ http\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ authtoken\\ .*"))) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.exe\\ authtoken\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.exe\\ start\\ \\-\\-all.*")))
